items.title: OpenAI models and Codex accessible through Oracle Cloud
items.summary: OpenAI has announced that its models, including Codex, are now accessible through Oracle Cloud. This integration allows developers to leverage existing cloud commitments to build and deploy AI solutions, ensuring enterprise-grade security and governance. The move enhances capabilities for businesses relying on Oracle infrastructure, facilitating a seamless integration of AI tools with robust cloud services. This development signifies a strategic partnership aimed at increasing the accessibility and scalability of AI technologies within enterprise environments.
items.why_it_matters: Tech leads can now deploy AI models on Oracle Cloud, providing enhanced security and scalability for enterprise applications.

items.title: PRC-linked influence operations targeting US AI debates
items.summary: OpenAI has released a report highlighting PRC-linked influence operations that utilize AI to infiltrate US tech debates. These operations focus on narratives related to data centers, tariffs, and false claims about ChatGPT, aiming to sway public and policy opinions. The report underscores the role of AI in orchestrating sophisticated information campaigns that could impact technology policy and international relations. This revelation raises concerns about the security and integrity of AI-driven communications.
items.why_it_matters: Understanding these influence operations is crucial for tech leaders to safeguard AI systems and data from misuse in geopolitical contexts.
